entries.en: Fact: Antarctic blue whales can weigh 112,000kg (250,000lb) and still swim at 25+ km/h (18 mp/h).

entries.en: Fact: Dogs have a unique sense of smell and are even able to detect diseases like cancer and changes in blood sugar levels in people with diabetes.

entries.zh: 小知识: 鸭子的喙结构特殊，能让它们一边游泳，一边从水和泥里滤出食物。

entries.en: Fact: Foxes have a unique hunting technique where they use the Earth's magnetic field to pinpoint the exact location of their prey.
entries.zh: 小知识: 狐狸有独特的捕猎技巧，能利用地球磁场精确定位猎物。

entries.en: Fact: Hippos secrete a sticky pink substance called "blood sweat" that acts as a natural sunscreen and moisturizer for their sensitive skin.

entries.zh: 小知识: 人们发现，猴子会拿自己的毛当牙线，清理牙缝。

entries.en: Fact: Pandas have a "pseudo thumb" made of an elongated wrist bone that helps them hold bamboo stalks.

entries.zh: 小知识: 企鹅眼睛上方有一种特殊的腺体，能过滤摄入海水中的盐分。

entries.en: Fact: Sheeps have an excellent sense of smell and can recognize individual members of their flock by their unique scent.

entries.en: Fact: Squids have the ability to change the color and texture of their skin to blend in with their surroundings, communicate with other squids and even hypnotize their prey.

entries.en: Fact: Toads have glands behind their eyes that secrete bufotoxin, which can cause hallucinations, seizures and death in predators that try to eat them.
entries.zh: 小知识: 蟾蜍眼后有能分泌蟾毒的腺体。试图吃掉它们的捕食者可能因此出现幻觉、抽搐，甚至死亡。

entries.zh: 我刚找到一份新工作,却不知道地址该怎么走。

entries.en: I just had a very very strange dream...
entries.zh: 我刚做了一个非常非常奇怪的梦……

entries.en: I just like to look at them, you see.
entries.zh: 其实啊,我就是喜欢看看它们。

entries.en: I just like to talk, I can go on for hours
entries.zh: 我就是喜欢说话,能说上几个小时

entries.en: I just need one last thing, there's an extremely dangerous scientist who sells an assortment of items, he has a special rounded type of gold. Try to convince him to sell you it.
entries.zh: 只差最后一样了。有个极其危险的科学家在卖各种东西,他手里有一种特殊的球状黄金。想办法说服他卖给你吧。

entries.en: I just talk about random things
I just want the Timecharm and I'm out.
I just want to eat something other than nether wart for once in my life...
entries.zh: 我这辈子就想吃一次下界疣以外的东西……

entries.en: I just wanted to see what you would say
entries.zh: 我只是想看看你会说什么

entries.en: I keep finding Phanpyres, but what I'm really looking for are Dreadwings.
entries.zh: 我找到的总是 Phanpyre,可我真正想找的是 Dreadwing。

entries.en: I keep on forgetting about Sulphur...
entries.zh: 我总是忘记硫磺这回事……

entries.en: I keep thinking about Jake's behavior...
entries.zh: 我一直在琢磨杰伊克的那些举动……

entries.en: I knew I could count on you.
I knew I saw one of those Seers grab it for themselves.
entries.zh: 我就说没看错，果然是哪个先知把它顺走了。

entries.en: I knew a time without adventurers, without banks and auctions
entries.zh: 我经历过那个没有冒险者、没有银行也没有拍卖行的年代

entries.en: I knew the location of a treasure right right close to a giant Dwarf Statue.
entries.zh: 我知道有件宝藏就在一座巨大的矮人雕像旁边。

entries.en: I knew you could do it!
I knew you would come to terms. Pleasure doing business with you.
entries.zh: 我就知道你会同意。和你做生意很愉快。

entries.en: I knew you would come, I saw it in the flames a few minutes ago.
entries.zh: 我就知道你会来。几分钟前,火焰已经把这一幕告诉了我。

entries.en: I knew you would say that.
I know I said there is no cake.
entries.zh: 我知道我说过没有蛋糕。

entries.en: I know I'll catch him doing something!
entries.zh: 我一定能逮到他在做什么!

entries.en: I know a spot down in the caves but I just have no idea how to get into that room, the entrance is tiny.
entries.zh: 我知道下面洞穴里有个地方，可实在不知道怎么进那个房间，入口太小了。

entries.en: I know it seems... wrong. But these experiments could change everything.
entries.zh: 我知道，这看起来……不太对。但这些实验也许能改变一切。

entries.en: I know it's a lot, so feel free to come back later if you're busy.
entries.zh: 我知道数量很多,所以如果你正忙,晚点再来也没关系。

entries.en: I know so many things about Kuudra.
entries.zh: 关于 Kuudra,我知道的可多了。

entries.en: I know that Gavin uses /scg instead of looking in his Fishing Skill menu.
entries.zh: §f我知道§b加文§f不查看自己的§a钓鱼技能§f菜单§f,而是使用 §d/scg。

entries.en: I know that you are a mole
I know the Dean's Apprentice, they would never take that much damage from the monsters around here.
entries.zh: 我了解院长的学徒,附近这些怪物不可能把他伤成这样。

entries.en: I know this as you have that intriguing item!
entries.zh: 我看得出来,因为你带着那件耐人寻味的物品!

entries.en: I know what all the others say, but I am the King's true favorite emissary.
entries.zh: 我知道别人都是怎么说的,但我才是国王真正最喜欢的委托官。

entries.en: I know why, but I'm not telling.
entries.zh: 我知道为什么,但我不打算告诉你。

entries.en: I know, I was careless, I was on a mission for...
entries.zh: 我知道,是我大意了。我当时正在执行……

entries.en: I know, it's an arduous process.
entries.zh: 我知道，这个过程确实挺费劲。

entries.en: I know. Don't you remember me?
entries.zh: 我知道。你不记得我了吗？
我上次见到大海，已经是

entries.en: I last saw the sea %1$s years, %2$s months ago.
entries.zh: §f我上次见到大海，已经是§b%1$s 年 %2$s 个月§f前了。

entries.en: I learned more than I could have from success alone.
entries.zh: 这次失败教会我的,可比一帆风顺多得多。

entries.en: I lied about having an important meeting just to be here, glad it was worth it!
entries.zh: 为了来这儿我谎称自己有重要会议,还好这一趟值得!

entries.en: I like events but I prefer uneventful days
entries.zh: 我喜欢活动,但更喜欢平淡无事的日子

entries.en: I like fishing in Hotspots that grant α Sea Creature Chance because I love finding new Sea Creatures!
entries.zh: §f我喜欢能提高 §3α 海怪几率§f的§d热点§f,因为我就爱寻找新的§3海洋生物§f!

entries.en: I like him just the way he is!
entries.zh: §f我§d喜欢§f的就是他§f原本的样子§f!

entries.en: I like it better down here, there are people like you
entries.zh: 我更喜欢待在下面这里,这儿有像你这样的人

entries.en: I like it though, it creates opportunities for everyone
entries.zh: 不过我倒挺喜欢的,这给了每个人机会

entries.en: I like mine with a lot of milk.
entries.zh: 我喜欢多加好多牛奶的那种。

entries.en: I like seeing the world evolve through time
entries.zh: 我喜欢看着这个世界随时间演变

entries.en: I like staying here with my spiders, but
entries.zh: 我喜欢待在这儿陪我的蜘蛛,可是

entries.en: I like staying here with my spiders, but Arachne started capturing some of them.
entries.zh: §f我喜欢待在这儿陪我的蜘蛛,可是§4阿拉克涅§f开始抓走它们了。

entries.en: I like to drag my feet because it's more time out of the house.
entries.zh: 我就喜欢慢吞吞地走,这样能在外面多待会儿。

entries.en: I like to press a flower for each place the Carnival stops at. Do you have any?
entries.zh: 狂欢节每到一处,我都喜欢压一朵花留念。你有花吗?

entries.en: I like to study cats, and I think they sometimes study me.
entries.zh: 我喜欢研究猫,有时候我觉得它们也在研究我。

entries.en: I like to use this path to go to the
I like to use this path to go to the Cathedral.
I like to visit people's private islands with my hot air balloon.
entries.zh: 我喜欢乘热气球参观别人的私人岛屿。

entries.en: I like visiting islands, some more than others
entries.zh: 我喜欢到处逛小岛,当然有些更喜欢一些

entries.en: I like watching Nether Warts grow. If you look closely you can see it grow, I think.
entries.zh: 我喜欢看下界疣生长。仔细盯着的话,应该能看见它长大……大概。

entries.en: I liked reading and listening to birds
I live for two things: receiving gifts and gifting others.
entries.zh: 我这辈子就爱两件事: 收礼物,还有送礼物。

entries.en: I look like a fool now.

entries.zh: 我的 Ubik 魔方丢了。

entries.en: I lost the Enchanted Bone Meal... of course...
entries.zh: 我把附魔骨粉弄丢了……果然……

entries.en: I lost them. Got to be around here somewhere...
entries.zh: 跟丢了。一定还躲在这附近……

entries.en: I love Rhanora's cats, but she wont let me play with any of them!
entries.zh: §f我很喜欢 §5拉诺拉§f的猫,可她一只都不肯让我陪着玩!

entries.en: I love diving and fishing. The world is much simpler when you live on the beach.
entries.zh: 我喜欢潜水和钓鱼。住在海滩上,世界会简单得多。

entries.en: I love it so much that I bought an industrial strength snow machine so that I can have snow on demand!
entries.zh: 我喜欢雪喜欢到买了台工业级造雪机,这样想看雪就有雪!

entries.en: I love my job, I do.

entries.zh: 我喜欢大自然,也喜欢动物。

entries.en: I love roses! Can you get more?
entries.zh: 我爱玫瑰! 还能再找些吗?

entries.en: I love sprays! So many colors!
entries.zh: 我太爱喷绘了! 五颜六色的!

entries.en: I love spring! It's not too hot or too cold, it's perfect!
entries.zh: 我最爱春天了! 不冷不热,刚刚好!

entries.en: I love talking, but I also think a lot!
entries.zh: 我喜欢说话,但我也很喜欢思考!

entries.en: I love the feel of the wind in my hair!
entries.zh: 风吹过头发的感觉真舒服!

entries.en: I love the sound of coins in the morning.
entries.zh: 我喜欢清晨硬币碰撞的声音。

entries.en: I love the sound of the waves!
I love the taste of the salt in the air!
entries.zh: 空气里这股咸咸的味道,真让人喜欢!

entries.en: I love your fighting spirit, but I am immune to your tricks!
entries.zh: 我喜欢你们的斗志，但你们的把戏对我没用!

entries.en: I loved those 3 little devils with all my heart and gave them all the care in the world
entries.zh: 我全心全意地爱着那3只小家伙,把能给的照顾全都给了它们

entries.en: I made one especially for you, here you go.
entries.zh: 我特地给你做了一块,拿去吧。

entries.en: I made, you can have it!
I manage the Year of the Witch Shop, where you can exchange ingredients from the event for rewards.
entries.zh: §f我经营着§5女巫年商店§f，你可以用活动中获得的§6材料§f兑换奖励。

entries.en: I managed to find one behind a spider egg, but once again I just couldn't reach it...
entries.zh: 我在一颗蜘蛛卵后面找到了一件，可惜又是够不着……

entries.en: I managed to follow him into the cave today, he had a shovel with him and a note fell out of his pocket...
entries.zh: 今天我成功跟他进了洞。他带着一把铲子,还有张纸条从口袋里掉了出来……

entries.en: I may be shorter than you, but I work for two!
entries.zh: 我个头没你高,干活可顶俩!

entries.en: I mean it's pretty dark outside.
I mean look at it! Look!
I mean of course it does, because I am a genius!
entries.zh: 不对不对,当然说得通,因为我是个天才!

entries.en: I mean seriously, what is your problem?
entries.zh: 我说真的,你到底有什么毛病?

entries.en: I mean technically I said I didn't wanna be a cow anymore and you kind of did what I asked of you...
entries.zh: 好吧严格来说,我确实说了不想再当牛,你也算是照我说的做了……

entries.en: I mean that would be pretty crazy wouldn't it be?
entries.zh: 我是说,那可就太离谱了,对吧?

entries.en: I mean, I'm supposed to ask you for something, right?
entries.zh: 我是说,我是不是该找你要点东西来着?

entries.en: I mean...I don't know, sure, just take my contact.
entries.zh: 我是说……算了，我也不知道，好吧，联系方式拿去。

entries.en: I met Captain Baha when I was marooned on a distant pirate cove.
entries.zh: §f我被困在遥远的§a海盗湾§f时遇见了§6船长 Baha§f。

entries.en: I met a guy called Jerry too
entries.zh: 我还见过一个叫杰瑞的家伙

entries.en: I might also die finding those items and you'll have that on your conscience.
entries.zh: 我去找那些东西时也可能送命,到时你良心上可得背着这件事。

entries.en: I might even be able to give them new abilities!
entries.zh: 我甚至还能赋予它们新的能力!

entries.en: I might give you something if you succeed.
entries.zh: 要是成功了,说不定我会送你点什么。

entries.en: I miscalculated, I need more for my research.
entries.zh: 我算错了,研究还需要更多材料。
为了排这个队，我连早饭都没吃。

entries.en: I mostly write fictions. Because you helped me, I'll tell you some of the plot.
entries.zh: 我主要写虚构故事。看在你帮过我的份上,给你透露一点情节吧。

entries.en: I must pray at home, for it is late.
entries.zh: 天色晚了,我得回家祈祷。

entries.en: I must say, this Garden is starting to grow on me. Figuratively, of course.
entries.zh: 我得说,这个花园开始让我喜欢上了。当然是比喻意义上。

entries.en: I must've missed it since I ended up here.
entries.zh: 结果到了这儿，看来是挖过头了。

entries.en: I myself know where the IQ Point is. Watch as I open a box that I know is empty.
entries.zh: §f我知道§e智商点§f在哪儿。看好了，我要打开一个我知道是空的箱子。

entries.en: I need 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks.
entries.zh: 我需要 §22 份 Spectre Dust、§23 份 Blaze Ashes 和 §24 块 Magma Chunk。

entries.en: I need 64 Birch Logs. Could you grab 'em for me?
entries.zh: §f我需要 §a64 根白桦原木§f,能帮我弄来吗?

entries.en: I need a couple more components, the next one is a
entries.zh: 还缺几种组件。下一种是

entries.en: I need a couple more components, the next one is a Lumino Fiber.
entries.zh: 还缺几种组件。下一种是§2光耀纤维§f。

entries.en: I need a lot of string to fix the pulley system, could you bring me 64 of it?
entries.zh: 修滑轮系统需要很多线，你能给我带 64 个来吗?

entries.en: I need a new recommendation letter.
entries.zh: 我需要一封新的推荐信。

entries.en: I need a ridiculous amount of flowers.
I need a sense of belonging.
I need him to explain himself.

entries.zh: 我需要更多瓶子! 更多!

entries.en: I need one more ingredient to make The Cake for the next person I can get to listen to me.
entries.zh: 我还差一样材料,就能给下一个肯听我说话的人做「那个蛋糕」了。

entries.en: I need some cobblestone to correct the base of the windmill, could you bring me 64 of it?
entries.zh: 修整风车底座需要一些圆石，你能给我带 64 个来吗?
我需要品质上乘的蘑菇。

entries.en: I need some time to figure out how to empower the
entries.zh: 我需要些时间,想想怎么增强这条

entries.en: I need some time to figure out how to empower the necklace...
entries.zh: §f我需要些时间,想想怎么增强这条§d项链§f……

entries.en: I need the EXACT amount I asked for!
entries.zh: 我需要的必须一件不多、一件不少!

entries.en: I need the perfect stew for my beloved
I need the perfect stew for my beloved Juliette.
entries.zh: §f我要给挚爱的 §eJuliette§f 做一锅完美的炖汤。

entries.en: I need to figure out just how smart you are.
entries.zh: 我得弄清楚，你究竟有多聪明。

entries.en: I need to think. I need to think.
entries.zh: 我得想想。我得好好想想。

entries.en: I need to wake up and work on myself.
entries.zh: 我得清醒过来，好好改变自己。

entries.en: I need you to collect each Glyph and bring them to me!
entries.zh: §f我需要你§a收集§f每一种§5符文§f，把它们带回来!

entries.en: I need you to hold your
I need you to hold your %s so I can upgrade it!
entries.zh: §c把 §f%s§c 拿在手上,我才能给它升级!

entries.en: I need your help to win
entries.zh: 我需要你帮我重新赢回

entries.en: I need your help to win Juliette back.
entries.zh: §f我需要你帮我重新赢回 §eJuliette§f 的心。

entries.en: I needed 2 Spectre Dust, 3 Blaze Ashes, 4 Magma Chunks.
entries.zh: 我要的是 §22 份 Spectre Dust、§23 份 Blaze Ashes 和 §24 块 Magma Chunk。

entries.en: I never understood the reason we had to leave them be, I wanted them out
entries.zh: 我一直不明白为什么非得由着它们,我只想把它们赶出去

entries.en: I no longer wish to fight, but I know that will not stop you.
entries.zh: 我已经不想再打了，可我知道这拦不住你们。

entries.en: I noticed you don't have a Snow Cannon, would you like to buy another?
entries.zh: 你身上好像没有雪炮,要再买一门吗?

entries.en: I now comprehend my purpose here.
entries.zh: 如今，我终于明白自己在此的使命。

entries.en: I now spend my days learning about Kuudra.
entries.zh: 如今我每天都在钻研 Kuudra。

entries.en: I offer thee my dearest possession, a small recompense for thy heroic deeds.
entries.zh: §f我把我§a最珍视的宝物§f送给你,聊表谢意,报答你的英雄之举。

entries.en: I often need flowers, feel free to come back in a few days.
entries.zh: 我经常需要花,过几天随时可以再来。

entries.en: I once dumped a magical water bucket into the toilet. It won't stop overflowing. Anyway, you got something for me?
entries.zh: 我之前用魔法水桶往马桶里倒过水,结果它到现在还在往外冒水。先不说这个了,我要的东西有了吗?

entries.en: I once stumbled upon a hidden lake in these parts, Some unsavory characters living there robbed me of all my gold!
entries.zh: 我有一次误打误撞找到了这一带一个隐秘的湖,结果住在那儿的几个不三不四的家伙把我的金子抢了个精光!

entries.en: I once tried a clear pond. Too shiny. Never again.
entries.zh: 我去过一次清澈的池塘。太亮了。再也不去了。
我不是只卖一种东西吗?

entries.en: I only test people who use their bare skills. No extra help allowed! Come back to me once you've
entries.zh: 我只考验不借外物的真本事。不许带任何帮手! 把

entries.en: I only test people who use their bare skills. No extra help allowed! Come back to me once you've stored your items away.
entries.zh: §f我只考验不借外物的真本事。不许带任何帮手! 把§e物品全存好§f再来。

entries.en: I only want an Abiphone Basic.
entries.zh: 我只要一台 Abiphone Basic 就行。

entries.en: I ordered a snack down to my room in the Catacombs. Took them years to find me, and even then they forgot the toppings!
entries.zh: 我在地牢的房间点了份零食。他们花了好几年才找到我,结果还忘了配料!

entries.en: I organize farming contests once every few days!
entries.zh: 我隔几天就办一场农业竞赛!

entries.en: I owe a lot of money to someone... Someone important.
entries.zh: 我欠了一个人很多钱……一个很有分量的人。

entries.en: I paid for one of Treasure Hunter's tips today and again, it only led me to a dirty shoelace. His tips are just not worth it...
entries.zh: 我今天又花钱买了寻宝人的一条提示,结果又只找到一根脏鞋带。他的提示根本不值……

entries.en: I paint all sorts of things, but it costs a lot of colored dyes.
entries.zh: 我什么都画,但得用掉很多彩色染料。

entries.en: I prefer the open water. More peaceful, less Ghasts!
entries.zh: 我还是喜欢在开阔的水面钓鱼。清静多了,恶魂也少!

entries.en: I prefer when the fishes are lively and go splish-splash in the water!
entries.zh: 我还是更喜欢活蹦乱跳、在水里扑腾的鱼!

entries.en: I provide the Piglins with important items.
entries.zh: 我负责给猪灵供应重要物资。

entries.en: I provide the Taika with important items.
entries.zh: 我负责为 Taika 族供应重要物资。

entries.en: I provide the faction with important items.
entries.zh: 我负责为阵营供应重要物资。

entries.en: I quit my previous job for this. It HAS to work.
entries.zh: 我连上一份工作都辞了,这次必须成功。

entries.en: I ran out of time long ago, probably.
entries.zh: 大概,我很久以前就用光了时间。

entries.en: I read in the Rift Herald that Barry wants to make jumping illegal!
entries.zh: §f我在§d裂隙先驱报§f上看到，Barry 想禁止跳跃!

entries.en: I read it too from time to time. It gives me valuable insights into my experiments!
entries.zh: 我偶尔也会读。它总能给我的实验带来宝贵启发!

entries.en: I really don't deserve such a skilled trainer.
entries.zh: 我何德何能,能有你这么厉害的教练。
我是真的很喜欢研究动物。

entries.en: I really have to do everything around here.
entries.zh: 这里怎么什么事都得我来做。

entries.en: I really hope I'll be ready on time.
entries.zh: 真希望我能及时准备好。

entries.en: I really need to get back to work.
I really thought I was finally good at something for a while, you know?
entries.zh: 你知道吗?有那么一阵子,我真以为自己终于有件事做得不错了。

entries.en: I recommend you gear up in the
I recommend you gear up in the Combat Settlement. You should talk to Rosetta, she has some great armor for sale!
entries.zh: §f我建议你去§c战斗聚落§f整备装备。你应该找罗塞塔聊聊,她那里有很不错的护甲出售!

entries.en: I refuse to speak with guests!
I remember meeting you, out there.
entries.zh: §f我记得见过你，就在§a外面的世界§f。

entries.en: I remember there was a stone pillar made only of cobblestone in the oasis, could be something there.
entries.zh: 我记得绿洲里有根全用圆石砌的柱子,那儿也许有东西。

entries.en: I remember when you proved your identity to the
I remember when you proved your identity to the Eleanors...
entries.zh: §f我记得，你向 §dEleanors§f 证明自己身份的时候……

entries.en: I resolve to barricade my abode with materials at hand.
entries.zh: §f我决定用手边的材料§c封住§f自己的居所。

entries.en: I respect you for making it to here, but I'll be your undoing.
entries.zh: 能走到这里，我敬你们几分——但你们会栽在我手上。

entries.en: I s'pose you could have it, if you can help me out first.
entries.zh: 给你也行,不过你得先帮我个忙。

entries.en: I said don't worry about that!
entries.zh: 我说了,这个你不用操心!

entries.en: I saved a bee from a pool once.
entries.zh: 有次,我从水池里救起一只蜜蜂。
前几天,我见到一只特别奇怪的

entries.en: I saw a really strange %1$s Critter the other day...
entries.zh: §f前几天,我见到一只特别奇怪的§a%1$s 小动物§f……

entries.en: I saw it on the horizon this morning and made my way over.
entries.zh: 我今早在地平线上看到了它,于是便赶了过来。

entries.en: I saw some treasure by a cow skull near the village.
entries.zh: 我在村子附近的牛头骨旁见过宝藏。

entries.en: I saw some weird guy in a mask go into a tiny hole inside the Dwarven Mines, maybe he's part of the Cult of the Fallen Star?
entries.zh: 我看见一个戴面具的怪人钻进了矮人矿山里的一个小洞,他会不会是“陨落之星教团”的人?

entries.en: I saw something near a farmer's cart, you should check it out.
entries.zh: 我在农夫的推车附近看到了什么,你去瞧瞧吧。

entries.en: I saw what happened! I saw everything!
entries.zh: 我看见了! 整件事我都看见了!

entries.en: I saw what happened. I saw everything!
entries.zh: 刚才的事我看见了。我全都看见了!

entries.en: I say King, but ever since Dulin returned, whispers are going around of him being the true king.
entries.zh: §f我说是§6国王§f,但自从§6杜林§f回归之后,坊间就一直在传,说他才是§6§o真正的§f国王。

entries.en: I searched all my life to find this creature but was never able to find it!
entries.zh: 我找了它一辈子，却一直没能找到!

entries.en: I see that one day you will join our faction... You shall will become a great asset...
entries.zh: 我看见终有一天,你会加入我们的阵营……你将成为不可多得的助力……

entries.en: I see that you will betray us one day, and join the Barbarian faction...
entries.zh: 我看见有一天,你会背叛我们,转而加入野蛮人阵营……

entries.en: I see they've figured out how to damage Thorn. Finally.
entries.zh: 看来他们终于弄明白怎么伤到索恩了。

entries.en: I see where this is going
entries.zh: 我大概猜到后面的发展了。

entries.en: I see you have Shen's Ringalia.
I see you have something in your inventory...
entries.zh: 我看到你物品栏里有样东西……

entries.en: I see you holding something there...
entries.zh: 我看见你手里拿着什么了……

entries.en: I see you've found some Gifts, but there are still many more in the village. Find the rest and come back for a reward!
entries.zh: 看来你已经找到一些礼物了,不过村子里还藏着不少呢。把剩下的找齐,再来领奖吧!

entries.en: I see you've found yourself in my cavernous kingdom.
entries.zh: 看来你发现了我这洞穴王国。

entries.en: I see you've hacked all the terminals, that's good...
entries.zh: §f我看到你已经§c黑进§f所有终端了，很好……

entries.en: I see, we owe you adventurer, this object is of great value to us.
entries.zh: 原来如此。冒险者,我们欠你一份人情,这件东西对我们极其珍贵。

entries.en: I see. And how many brackets are there?
entries.zh: 原来如此。那一共有几个税档?

entries.en: I see. Hopefully next time I see you, you won't be needing anything that requires anything from me...
entries.zh: 我明白了。希望下次见你时,你不会需要任何得向我索取材料的东西……

entries.en: I see. In that case, our discussion concludes here.
entries.zh: 明白了。那就谈到这里吧。

entries.en: I see. Well, take it then.
I see. Would you like to delve deeper into their story?
entries.zh: 这样啊。想多了解一下它们的故事吗?

entries.en: I see. You have forced me to use my ultimate technique.
entries.zh: 原来如此。你们逼我使出终极招式了。
原来如此……你有 Saul 的

entries.en: I see.. you have a recommendation letter from Saul. Well, I guess its OK then, I suppose.
entries.zh: §f原来如此……你有 Saul 的§6推荐信§f。好吧，那应该可以……大概吧。

entries.en: I see... I see you... Fighting... The vision is quite blurry...
entries.zh: 我看见了……我看见你……在战斗……画面非常模糊……

entries.en: I seem to be having some issues warping you... Check again soon!
entries.zh: 我好像没法把你传送过去……稍后再试试!

entries.en: I seem to recall seeing something near the well in the village.
entries.zh: 我好像在村里的水井附近见过什么。

entries.en: I seen a Hivethief or two show up sometimes.
I sell Abiphones straight from the Mage faction.
entries.zh: 我卖的 Abiphone 都是从法师阵营直接弄来的。

entries.en: I sell Arrows and Bows for a truly overpriced amount!
entries.zh: 我这儿卖箭和弓，价格嘛，贵得离谱!

entries.en: I sell all kinds of them if you'd like to try one out!
entries.zh: 我这里各式各样的都有,想试试的话就来买吧!

entries.en: I sense many dead spirits eager to return to the living..
entries.zh: 我感觉到有不少亡魂急着还阳……

entries.en: I sent a gift to your inventory! With love, St. Jerry.
entries.zh: 礼物已经送进你的物品栏啦! 送上满满的祝福,圣杰瑞。

entries.en: I sent my son Ugo on a mission to recover the Sulphur.
entries.zh: 我派儿子 Ugo 去追回硫磺。

entries.en: I should get my order filled first
I should go out with my friends soon, maybe get some ice cream.
entries.zh: 我该找朋友们出去玩玩了,顺便吃个冰淇淋。

entries.en: I should go talk to the Wizard again...
I should have known that I stood no chance.
entries.zh: 我早该知道自己毫无胜算。

entries.en: I should probably go and tell her that she's supposed to be at work.
entries.zh: 我最好还是过去告诉她一声,她今天该上班。

entries.en: I should talk to the detective now...
I should tell Barry about Creed's complaints...
I should tell Barry about Dust's complaints...
I should tell Barry about Frankie's complaints...
I should tell Barry about Harriette's complaints...
I should tell Barry about Soma's complaints...
I should tell Barry about Stain's complaints...
I should tell Barry about Violetta's complaints...
I should warn you, though, the connection can be a bit spotty around these parts!
entries.zh: 不过先说好,这附近的信号不太稳定!

entries.en: I shouldn't have put so many Coins on this match..
entries.zh: 我不该在这场比赛押这么多硬币……

entries.en: I solemnly swear I am up to no good.
entries.zh: 我庄严宣誓,我没干好事。

entries.en: I spent a week training my body, but I think my mind improved even more.
entries.zh: 我花了一周锻炼身体,可我的心境似乎成长得更多。

entries.en: I spent... years... crafting... this magical scroll...
entries.zh: 我花了...好多年...才做出...这张魔法卷轴...

entries.en: I spotted something by an odd looking mushroom on one of the ledges in the Mushroom Gorge, you should check it out.
entries.zh: 蘑菇峡谷有处岩台,上面长着一株奇怪的蘑菇。我在它旁边发现了东西,你去瞧瞧吧。

entries.en: I stepped into the Rift to help with the elections...
entries.zh: §f我踏入§d裂隙§f，是为了帮忙筹办选举……
我手里现在还留着一些

entries.en: I still have no idea where all that interest is coming from
entries.zh: 我到现在都搞不懂那些利息到底是从哪儿来的

entries.en: I still need to think, but I'll probably want to talk again later. Come back tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我还需要想想,不过我大概之后还会想再聊聊的。明天再来吧。

entries.en: I stopped what I was doing and tried my best to catch it...but it got away.
entries.zh: 我立刻放下手里的活,拼命想抓住它……可还是让它跑了。

entries.en: I stumbled upon the design while clearing out a damp, old shed.
entries.zh: 我收拾一间潮湿的旧棚屋时,偶然发现了它们的设计图。
整个人一下子都舒坦了!

entries.en: I suggest utilizing it on various objects within this
I suggest utilizing it on various objects within this abode to uncover clues as to the whereabouts of the hapless victim.
entries.zh: §f建议你用它扫描这栋§c宅邸§f中的各样物件，寻找线索，查明那位不幸受害者的下落。

entries.en: I suppose I don't have a choice in the matter.
I suppose that's technically my fault, with all those
I suppose that's technically my fault, with all those new people in the Rift lately.
entries.zh: §f严格说这得怪我,最近§d裂隙§f里来了那么多§f§o新面孔§f。

entries.en: I suppose this is your very own kingdom in a sense, %1$s? Splendid.
entries.zh: 这么说,这里算是你自己的王国了,%1$s? 太棒了。

entries.en: I suppose we should recap them, just for the agenda.
entries.zh: 为了走个流程,我们还是复述一遍吧。

entries.en: I suppose we should recap them, just for the agenda. Brarnas, if you would...
entries.zh: §f为了走个流程,我们还是复述一遍吧。§5Brarnas§f,麻烦你……

entries.en: I suppose you have more than earned my contact! Here you go!
entries.zh: 看来你完全有资格得到我的联系方式! 拿去吧!

entries.en: I suppose you want my Abiphone Contact.
entries.zh: §f看来你想要我的 §3Abiphone 联系方式§f。

entries.en: I sure wish there was a record of all my accomplishments in one place!
entries.zh: 要是能把我的战绩都记在一处，那该多好啊!

entries.en: I suspect he has visited the local
I suspect he has visited the local blacksmith to obtain the necessary jewel.
entries.zh: §f我猜他去了本地的§6铁匠§f那里，寻找所需的宝石。

entries.en: I swear I wont get in that trouble again!
entries.zh: 我发誓,再也不惹上这种麻烦了!

entries.en: I talk a lot, so I've learned to just tune myself out.
entries.zh: 我话太多了，已经学会不听自己在说什么了。

entries.en: I talked to Swoop the other day, he explained a lot of interesting Foraging Mechanics to me.
entries.zh: §f前几天我和§b斯伍普§f聊了聊,他给我讲了不少有趣的§a伐木技巧§f。

entries.en: I tasked my assistant Kay with a critical component of my research, but clearly she forgot about me!
entries.zh: 我把一项关键的研究任务交给了助手 Kay，可她显然把我忘得一干二净了！

entries.en: I taught him everything I could, but there are things only friends can teach.
entries.zh: 我已经把能教的都教给了他,但有些事只有朋友能教。

entries.en: I taught you all I know about
I taught you all I know about Greenhouses, you are on your own from now on!
entries.zh: §f关于§a温室§f我知道的都教给你了,接下来就靠你自己啦!

entries.en: I taught you how to capture
I taught you how to capture Odonatas.
I tell 'em every time that it's open every day, but when they put down the phone I know they'll call 'n ask again tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我每回都说,天天都开。可他们电话一挂,我就知道明天准又要打来问。

entries.en: I tell ya, family gatherings got a lot more interesting when
I tell ya, family gatherings got a lot more interesting when Hoppity started bringing those experimental chocolates.
entries.zh: §f我跟你说,自从§a霍皮提§f开始带那些试验版巧克力来,家庭聚会就热闹多了。

entries.en: I thank thee, kind soul, for thy gracious aid.
entries.zh: 谢谢你,善良的人,多谢你慷慨相助。

entries.en: I think I am gonna get some rest soon.
entries.zh: 我想我该去休息一会儿了。

entries.en: I think I am really onto something here.
entries.zh: 我觉得自己这次真的发现了什么。

entries.en: I think I had dwarves somewhere in my family tree
entries.zh: 我觉得我祖上大概有矮人的血统

entries.en: I think I might be claustrophobic.
entries.zh: 我想,我可能有幽闭恐惧症。

entries.en: I think I see Jake on the edge of the ravine!
entries.zh: 我好像看见杰伊克在峡谷边上了!

entries.en: I think I'll become a motivational speaker.
entries.zh: 我觉得自己都能去当励志演说家了。

entries.en: I think I'll name her Aragog.
I think I'll stick around for a little longer, and then it's onto my next adventure!
entries.zh: 我想我还会在这里多待一会儿,然后就该去下一站冒险了!

entries.en: I think Jythar did it for her.
entries.zh: 我想,Jythar 是为了她才这么做的。

entries.en: I think a lot of what happens around here can serve as a life lesson
entries.zh: 我觉得这儿发生的很多事都能当作人生的一课

entries.en: I think all cats teleport to the same spiritual world when they dream.
entries.zh: 我觉得所有猫做梦时,都会传送到同一个灵界。

entries.en: I think he's trying to cover his tracks.
entries.zh: 我觉得他是在抹掉自己的踪迹。

entries.en: I think it was coming from here!
entries.zh: 声音好像是从这里传来的!

entries.en: I think it's going to break very soon.
entries.zh: 我觉得它马上就要被打破了。

entries.en: I think it's playing around the
I think it's playing around the Rift!
entries.zh: §f我猜它正在§5裂隙§f里到处玩呢!

entries.en: I think it's the Golden Goblin, it gives out free powder.
entries.zh: 我觉得那是黄金哥布林,它会白送粉末的。

entries.en: I think of slipping into the lava.
entries.zh: 我会想着干脆滑进岩浆里算了。

entries.en: I think the Automatons nearby are built with similar components. Find them and bring them to me!
entries.zh: 我想附近那些机关傀儡用的应该是同类部件。找到它们,带来给我!

entries.en: I think the Treasure Hunter is a scammer.
entries.zh: 我觉得寻宝猎人是个骗子。

entries.en: I think the best way to get out is for
entries.zh: 我觉得最好的逃生办法是让

entries.en: I think the best way to get out is for The Matriarch to spit you out, but I'll admit I don't know how.
entries.zh: 我觉得最好的逃生办法是让§c女族长§f把你吐出来，不过老实说，我不知道该怎么让它这么做。

entries.en: I think the reason is love.
I think they are learning, one day they will take control
entries.zh: 我觉得它们在学习,总有一天会掌权

entries.en: I think they are usually around the
I think they are usually around the Colosseum.
entries.zh: §f他们平时好像就在§a斗兽场§f附近。

entries.en: I think they decided to break the world to weaken us, and by us I mean everyone in this dimension.
entries.zh: 我认为,它们决定击碎世界来削弱我们——我说的我们,是这个维度里的所有人。

entries.en: I think this is the way?
I think this new story will be my masterpiece.
entries.zh: 我觉得这个新故事会成为我的巅峰之作。

entries.en: I think this spot would work perfectly!
entries.zh: 我看这个位置就再合适不过了!

entries.en: I think we got demoted for some reason...
entries.zh: 不知怎么的,我们好像被降职了……

entries.en: I think we should go to the florist because the bouquet over there was made with love.
entries.zh: 我想应该去找花匠，因为那边的花束饱含爱意。

entries.en: I think you are making a mistake, perhaps the biggest mistake of your life!
entries.zh: 我觉得你这决定可不明智,说不定会后悔一辈子!

entries.en: I think you might have lost this!
entries.zh: 我想，你可能把这个弄丢了!

entries.en: I think you should bring it with you to the overworld!
entries.zh: 我觉得你该把它带到外面的世界去!

entries.en: I think you should run for office.
entries.zh: 我觉得你应该去竞选公职。

entries.en: I think you'll find the answer to that question at the top of the
entries.zh: 我想，这个问题的答案就在

entries.en: I think you'll find the answer to that question at the top of the mountain, right here in the Rift.
entries.zh: §f我想，这个问题的答案就在§b山顶§f，就在§d裂隙§f里。

entries.en: I think your game is rigged anyway
entries.zh: 反正我觉得你这游戏动了手脚

entries.en: I thought I saw something near the smallest stone pillar in the oasis.
entries.zh: 我好像在绿洲最小的那根石柱旁看到了东西。

entries.en: I thought you'd be more thankful for the sweet axe my assistant gave you.
entries.zh: 我还以为你会更感激我助手送你的那把甜斧头。

entries.en: I threw the letter into the
I threw the letter into the breach, which broke the laws of causality.
entries.zh: §f我把信扔进§5裂口§f，这就打破了因果法则。

entries.en: I told Hoppity we should have a line of eco-friendly chocolates.
entries.zh: §f我跟§a霍皮提§f提议,咱们该出个环保巧克力系列。

entries.en: I told him I'd start my own movement: the 'chocolate mindfulness mindset'.
entries.zh: 我跟他说,我要自创一派:“巧克力正念心态”。

entries.en: I told you that you aren't popular enough yet to
I told you that you aren't popular enough yet to Shen to participate in his auctions!
entries.zh: 我说过,你在§6Shen§f眼里还不够有名,没资格参加他的拍卖!

entries.en: I took a break from work for too long! Now I need your help to meet my quota!
entries.zh: 我这假摸得有点久了! 现在得靠你帮我把指标凑上!

entries.en: I took the liberty to add
I took the liberty to add Dean to your contacts already. I made sure you couldn't remove it, accidents happen!
entries.zh: 我已经自作主张把§c迪恩§f加进你的§3联系人§f了,还特意设成不能删除——免得误操作嘛!

entries.en: I travel a lot and I'm running quite low on
I travel a lot and I'm running quite low on Silent Pearl.
entries.zh: §f我常年四处跑,手头的§9无声珍珠§f快用完了。

entries.en: I travel the world searching far and wide for the rarest pets I can find!
entries.zh: 我四处游历,就是为了寻找世上最稀有的宠物!

entries.en: I traveled all the way... just to be disappointed again.
entries.zh: 我大老远跑来……就为了再失望一次。

entries.en: I tried getting pets too but that didn't work very well.
entries.zh: 我也试过养宠物,但也不怎么顺利。

entries.en: I tried showing Granny how to build muscle mass.
I tried using the Time Gun on my tea once.
entries.zh: §f我曾经拿§9时光枪§f打过一次茶水。

entries.en: I turned and I could see myself standing behind that screen, right here.
entries.zh: 我转过身,看见自己就站在那道屏幕后面,就站在这里。

entries.en: I understand your words now, my master.
entries.zh: 我现在明白您的话了，我的主人。

entries.en: I unlocked Target Partice IV for you, good luck kiddo.
entries.zh: §f我给你解锁了§4靶场练习 IV§f,祝你好运,小子。

entries.en: I use a Void Sword, it's a very powerful weapon.
entries.zh: 我用的是§5虚空之剑§r,这武器可厉害了。

entries.en: I use all sorts of wood types to create strong and useful items!
entries.zh: 我用各种木材，做些结实又好用的东西!

entries.en: I use it in my Lapis Minion, those things fill terribly fast!
entries.zh: 我在自己的青金石小人上就装了一个,那东西装满得可快了!

entries.en: I use that experience to enchant my
I use that experience to enchant my Lapis Pickaxe with efficiency, which makes it mine faster!
entries.zh: §f我就用这些经验给§a青金石镐§f附上效率,这样挖起来就快多了!

entries.en: I use the top bed, because I'm the strongest.
I used to be a Dungeon adventurer, until I took an arrow to the elbow.
entries.zh: 我以前也是个地牢冒险者,直到手肘中了一箭。

entries.en: I used to chuck that ball like nobody's business. Those were the days, eh?
entries.zh: 想当年我那一手传球,谁见了不服气? 那才叫好日子啊。

entries.en: I used to go to the End a lot, not anymore
entries.zh: 我以前经常去末地,现在不去了

entries.en: I used to live in a small town, we had a house, 2 floors and an attic
entries.zh: 我曾经住在一个小镇上,我们家有栋房子,两层楼加一个阁楼

entries.en: I used to study animals from all over the land!
entries.zh: 以前我研究过各地的动物!

entries.en: I used to, because it seems like everything you CAN do is pre-determined, like a computer program.
entries.zh: 以前觉得有，毕竟我们能做的一切好像都早就定好了，跟电脑程序一样。

entries.en: I used to, but remembering who's still alive and who isn't is a nightmare.
entries.zh: 我以前会给，但要记住谁还活着、谁已经死了，简直是场噩梦。

entries.en: I usually only work with Oil Barrels, but I'd like to try making some Biofuel from compost.
entries.zh: 我平时只用油桶,不过我挺想试试拿堆肥做点生物燃料。

entries.en: I usually work in a nuclear power plant.
I value your farm at 0 coins. Horrible service.
entries.zh: 我给你的农场估值 0 硬币。服务糟透了。

entries.en: I volunteered to be part of the Safety Squad.
entries.zh: 我自愿加入了安全小队。

entries.en: I waited 30 seconds, my eyes fixed on the front door, holding my breath
entries.zh: 我等了30秒,眼睛死死盯着前门,屏住了呼吸

entries.en: I wake up this morning and all my chickens are GONE.
entries.zh: 今天早上我一醒来,所有鸡全都不见了。

entries.en: I want a cat pet but not the black one, bad memories
entries.zh: 我想要只猫宠物,但不要黑色的,有不好的回忆

entries.en: I want to improve every day, for the rest of my life.
entries.zh: 往后余生,我想每天都比昨天更好。

entries.en: I want to make a secret gift for Juliette.

entries.zh: Thormyr 不在这张桌子边的时候就只会睡觉和吃东西,别的什么都不做。

entries.en: Those Dashing Spiders are pretty obnoxious. I find a well-placed arrow can help with that.
entries.zh: 那些飞扑蜘蛛真是烦人。我发现，只要一箭射得准，就能解决。

entries.en: Those Energized Chunks really pack a punch when they explode! Try hitting them towards Kuudra!
entries.zh: 充能块爆炸时威力十足! 试着把它们打向 Kuudra!

entries.en: Those boys were bad news - they would take a bite out of anything!
entries.zh: 那些家伙可不好惹,见什么都想咬上一口!

entries.en: Those guys are solitary creatures and quite territorial, so you don't normally see them about.
entries.zh: 这些家伙喜欢独来独往,领地意识也很强,所以平时不太见得到。

entries.en: Those in his organization have committed
entries.zh: 他组织里的人干过一些

entries.en: Those in his organization have committed questionable acts.
entries.zh: §f他组织里的人干过一些§f§o见不得光§f的事。

entries.en: Those little guys actually only live for a few years, which is kinda sad...
entries.zh: 这些小家伙其实只能活几年,想想还有点难过……

entries.en: Those ones are going to be tougher to obtain though.
entries.zh: 只是这些东西会更难弄到。

entries.en: Those people are so rude. I feel sorry for Thorn.
entries.zh: 那些人太粗鲁了。我真替索恩难过。

entries.en: Those people will say that they believe in knowledge and magic.
entries.zh: 他们会说,自己信仰的是知识与魔法。

entries.en: Those questions keep getting tougher and tougher...
entries.zh: 这些题真是一道比一道难……

entries.en: Those things are actually insectivores and love digging tunnels.
entries.zh: 这些家伙吃昆虫,还特别爱挖隧道。

entries.en: Those things were pretty much walking fortresses - completely covered in bony deposits known as osteoderms that protected them from predators.
entries.zh: 这些家伙简直是行走的堡垒——全身覆着一种叫皮内成骨的骨质结构,保护它们免受掠食者伤害。

entries.en: Those tiny fish are super cute, that's mostly why I hunt them.
entries.zh: 那些小鱼实在太可爱了，我捕它们主要就是因为这个。

entries.en: Those toys are not strong enough I see.
entries.zh: 看起来那些玩具不够强。

entries.en: Those troublesome creatures are ruining everything and must be dealt with. Do you understand?
entries.zh: 那些麻烦的家伙正把一切搞得乱七八糟，必须处理掉。明白吗?

entries.en: Thou art a creature of delight,
Thou hast delivered me from death's cold grasp, when all seemed lost to cruel fate's design.
entries.zh: 就在我以为残酷的命运已成定局时，是你将我从死亡的冰冷掌心救了出来。

entries.en: Though I faltered, perhaps you will prevail.
entries.zh: 我没能做到的事，也许你能做到。

entries.en: Though I sit stationary in this prison that is
Though I sit stationary in this prison that is The Catacombs, my knowledge knows no bounds.
entries.zh: §f尽管我被困在§c地牢§f这座牢笼里动弹不得，我的学识却没有边界。

entries.en: Though Sun Gecko's power grows more daunting, you have found a way through once again.
entries.zh: §f虽然§e太阳壁虎§f的力量愈发强大，你还是再次找到了取胜之道。

entries.en: Though a novice, Bonzo is particularly eager to prove himself as worthy to his peers. Guarding the very first dungeon floor, he seeks to snuff things out before they become a problem - and has fun doing it!
entries.zh: 邦佐虽是个新人，却格外想向同伴证明自己。作为地牢第一层的守卫，他总想在麻烦成形前把它掐灭——而且乐在其中!

entries.en: Though beware, for your ф Rift Time shall deplete twice as fast.
entries.zh: §f不过要留意，你的 §aф 裂隙时间§f将以§c两倍的速度消耗§f。

entries.en: Though far too small to be habitable, it reminds a certain creature of home.
entries.zh: 虽小得无法住下,却能让某个小家伙想起家乡。

entries.en: Though it leaves a lot to be desired,
entries.zh: 但大概饱含了满满的心意。

entries.en: Though it may not be bluer visually,
entries.zh: 虽然看起来并没有更蓝，

entries.en: Though it may not be bluer visually, it is in spirit.
entries.zh: §8§o虽然看起来并没有更蓝，§8§o但它的灵魂更蓝了。

entries.zh: 不过,这可不会让它们的长牙显得没那么吓人……

entries.en: Though it's the coldest thing you'll find on

entries.zh: §7虽然是§c杰瑞的工坊§7里最冰冷的东西,却莫名让人感到安心。

entries.en: Though it's unfortunate you may fail like the others.
entries.zh: §f可惜，你也许还是会§c失败§f，和其他人一样。

entries.en: Though the name of Littlefoot is relatively unknown compared to that of his elder brother, he is determined to make a name for himself through any means necessary.
entries.zh: 与哥哥相比，Littlefoot 名不见经传，但他决心不择手段地闯出自己的名声。

entries.en: Though they look pretty scary, these guys mostly ate vegetation.
entries.zh: 这些家伙虽然看着挺吓人,其实主要吃植物。

entries.en: Though they're not very talkative fellows on account of being dead 'n all, you can still have a rummage through their backpacks for some loot!
entries.zh: 这些家伙毕竟都死了,也没法陪你聊天,不过你还是能翻翻他们的背包,找些战利品!

entries.en: Though this dino was covered in strong plating that would usually make it impervious to predators, it had a soft underbelly.
entries.zh: 这种恐龙浑身披着坚硬的甲片,掠食者通常奈何不了它,不过它的肚皮却很柔软。

entries.en: Though, if you have to live at the same time as a bloodthirsty predator like the T-Rex, it probably would help to have an armored body and bone-shatteringly strong tail.
entries.zh: 要跟霸王龙这种嗜血的掠食者活在同一个时代,有一身铠甲和一条能砸碎骨头的强壮尾巴,大概还是挺管用的。

entries.en: Though, while we can't cut them, what we can do is deface them a little...
entries.zh: 不过,虽说砍不了,稍微糟蹋一下还是可以的……

entries.en: Though, you might have to find me again.
entries.zh: 不过,可能得重新找一找我。

entries.en: Thought we ourselves are but a blink in th face of eternity, our friendship will be everlasting.
entries.zh: 虽然我们自身在永恒面前不过转瞬即逝，但我们的友谊将长存。

entries.en: Thought you could escape me, did you?
Thousands of Dragons attacked that day and all were defeated, but did they fail?
entries.zh: 那一天,数千条巨龙发起进攻,最终全军覆没——可它们真的失败了吗?

entries.zh: §b✆ §f我猜你是想要我的 §9Abiphone 联系方式§f,对吧?

entries.en: ✆ I have %s contacts on my Abiphone.
entries.zh: §b✆§f 我有 §c%s 位联系人§f,都在我的 Abiphone 里。

entries.en: ✆ I haven't received a present like that...ever I think.
entries.zh: ✆ 我想……我从没收到过这样的礼物。

entries.en: ✆ I heard the new models are nice, but they're too smart for me!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f听说新款挺不错,可惜太智能了,我玩不转!

entries.en: ✆ I hope it wasn't too much of a hassle to get, I've heard stories of The Catacombs...
entries.zh: §b✆ §f希望你找它没费太多工夫,我听说过§c地牢§f的那些故事...

entries.en: ✆ I know you are worried about me but I'm feeling fine right now.
entries.zh: ✆ 我知道你担心我,但我现在感觉很好。

entries.en: ✆ I like collecting rings. There is one I've been wanting for a while now.
entries.zh: ✆ 我喜欢收藏戒指。有一枚我已经想要很久了。

entries.en: ✆ I mean, I'm supposed to ask you for something, right?
entries.zh: §b✆ §f我是说,我是不是该找你要点东西来着?

entries.en: ✆ I need to finish my book.
✆ I only share my contact with those who are on Jacob's contact list.
entries.zh: ✆ 我只把联系方式给雅各布通讯录里的人。

entries.en: ✆ I s'pose you could have it, if you can help me out first.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f给你也行,不过你得先帮我个忙。

entries.en: ✆ I sent a gift to your inventory! With love, St. Jerry.
entries.zh: §b✆§f 礼物已经送进你的物品栏啦! 送上满满的祝福,圣杰瑞。

entries.en: ✆ I should warn you, though, the connection can be a bit spotty around these parts!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f不过先说好,这附近的信号不太稳定!

entries.en: ✆ I simply enjoy a more simple life, ye?
entries.zh: ✆ 我只是更喜欢简简单单地过日子,懂吧?

entries.en: ✆ I suppose I could do that.
✆ I suppose you have more than earned my contact! Here you go!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f看来你完全有资格得到我的联系方式! 拿去吧!

entries.en: ✆ I will stay in Scarleton and prepare for the next battle!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f我会留在绯红城,为下一场战斗做好准备!

entries.en: ✆ I'll give you my ...brr... Abiphone Contact in return.
entries.zh: §b✆§f 作为回报，我会把我的……嘶……§3Abiphone 联系方式§f给你。

entries.en: ✆ I'll give you my Abiphone Contact if you do.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f你要是帮我找来，我就把我的 §3Abiphone 联系方式§f给你。

entries.en: ✆ I'll let you know if you get it right.
✆ I'm currently hunting! Don't call again!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f我正打猎呢! 先别打过来了!

entries.en: ✆ I'm far from stupid, don't get me wrong, eh.
entries.zh: ✆ 别误会,我可一点都不傻,啊。

entries.en: ✆ I'm far too weak to take on Kuudra myself, but maybe one day...
entries.zh: ✆ 我现在还太弱，无法独自挑战 Kuudra，不过也许总有一天……

entries.en: ✆ I'm joking! Bring me Ultimate Carrot Candy x2.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f开玩笑的! 给我带 §6终极胡萝卜糖 §8x2§f 就行。

entries.en: ✆ I'm just a call away if you ever need me!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f有需要随时打给我,一个电话的事!

entries.en: ✆ I'm pretty busy right now, sorry.
✆ I'm sorry, but I'll have to call you back later. Enjoy your Abiphone!
entries.zh: §b✆ §r抱歉,晚点再回电。好好享受你的 §3Abiphone§f!

entries.en: ✆ I'm still getting calls from that one guy asking if I want to "extend my shovel warranty".
entries.zh: §b✆ §f到现在还有个家伙不停打来，问我要不要给铲子续保。

entries.en: ✆ I've always wanted one, but you can't find them around here, and I'm too scared to venture into The Catacombs in search of one.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f我一直想要一颗,可这附近找不到,我又不敢去§c地牢§f里找。

entries.en: ✆ I've heard they sometimes drop from Diamond Goblins.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f我听说§b钻石哥布林§f偶尔会掉这个。

entries.en: ✆ Ice Hunks and Blue Ice Hunks won't cut it anymore, unfortunately.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f可惜,§a冰块碎片§f和§9蓝冰碎片§f已经不够看了。

entries.en: ✆ If I dunk it over myself it should get rid of all the cold.
entries.zh: §b✆§f 我要是把它往身上一倒，应该就不会再冷了。

entries.en: ✆ If I give you my contact it's strictly business, right?
entries.zh: ✆ 如果把联系方式给你，就只谈生意，对吧?

entries.en: ✆ If I need any farming done back home, I'll be sure to call ya!
entries.zh: ✆ 家里要是有农活要干,我一定打给你!

entries.en: ✆ If there's really an emergency, come and see me!
✆ If you call me I probably won't feel like speaking, but I'll let you use the Forest Essence Shop.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f你打给我的时候，我可能不太想说话，不过你还是能用§2森林精华商店§f。

entries.en: ✆ If you can bring me a Bayou Water Orb, I'll give you my contact.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f给我带个§6沼泽水之球§f,我就给你联系方式。

entries.en: ✆ If you could find me one I'd really appreciate it.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f你要是能帮我找到一颗,我会非常感激。

entries.en: ✆ If you ever have a spare one, you know where to find me.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f等你有多余的了，就来找我吧。

entries.en: ✆ If you ever have the time, could you go to the Abandoned Quarry and fish around for my Speckled Teacup?
entries.zh: §b✆ §f你要是哪天有空,能不能去§2废弃采石场§f试着钓回我的 §cSpeckled Teacup§f?

entries.en: ✆ If you face the cathedral, there is a relay at the top of the left tower.
entries.zh: ✆ 面朝大教堂,左边塔楼的顶上就有一个中继。

entries.en: ✆ If you forgot, I'm after a Bayou Water Orb!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f怕你忘了,我想要的是§6沼泽水之球§f!

entries.en: ✆ If you give me 64 Purple Candy and 6 Ectoplasm, I might give you my contact.
entries.zh: §b✆§f 给我 64 个§5紫色糖果§f和 6 个§9灵质§f,我§f§o也许§f会把联系方式给你。

entries.en: ✆ If you had 5 Max Lvl pets of Legendary tier or better in your pet menu...
entries.zh: ✆ 要是你的宠物菜单里有 5 只满级的传说或更高稀有度的宠物……

entries.en: ✆ If you manage to find it, bring it back here and I'll be happy to give you my contact.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f你要是能找到它,拿回来给我,我很乐意把联系方式给你。

entries.en: ✆ If you want me in your phone, bring me a Winter Water Orb!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f想把我存进手机,就给我带一个§6寒冬水之球§f来!

entries.en: ✆ If you want my Abiphone Contact, you're gonna have to bring me the goods.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f想要我的 §3Abiphone 联系方式§f,得先把货带来。

entries.en: ✆ If you want my contact, all you have to do is repeat this phrase exactly...
entries.zh: §b✆§f 想加我的联系方式,只要把下面这句话原样复述一遍……

entries.en: ✆ Is this urgent? I'm working on my new novel at the moment.
entries.zh: ✆ 有急事吗? 我正在写新小说。

entries.en: ✆ It can get quite lonely up here sometimes, so I do a bunch of stuff to pass the time.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f有时候，待在这上面还挺孤单的，所以我会找些事情打发时间。

entries.en: ✆ It has 3 contact slots and I already have Tammy and Tony.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f它只能存 3 个联系人,塔米和托尼已经占了两个。

entries.en: ✆ It offers service to the whole village!
entries.zh: ✆ 整个村庄的信号都靠它!

entries.en: ✆ It will work on any Abiphone as long as I'm in your contacts list.
entries.zh: ✆ 只要我还在你的通讯录里,它在任何 Abiphone 上都能用。

entries.en: ✆ It's a long story but in short, we believe the Piglins stole it, it's a real problem.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f说来话长。简单讲,我们认为东西是猪灵偷走的,麻烦大了。

entries.en: ✆ It's in a very high place to reverb the signal for the royal council.
entries.zh: ✆ 它装在很高的地方,好把信号传给王室议会。

entries.en: ✆ It's on the face which looks at the moon rising.
entries.zh: ✆ 在朝着月亮升起的那一面。

entries.en: ✆ It's really as simple as that. I'll add myself to your Contacts now!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f就是这么简单。现在我会把自己加入你的§3联系人§f!

entries.en: ✆ It's somewhere in my hut. Place isn't too big so it shouldn't be too hard to find.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f就在我那小屋里。屋子不大,应该不难找。

entries.en: ✆ It's such a beautiful gem. Perhaps the most beautiful one of all.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f那种宝石太美了。也许是世上最美的一种。

entries.en: ✆ Lesson learned, I'm never letting anyone borrow it ever again - even my regulars!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f这回我算是长记性了,以后谁也别想再借走它——老主顾也不行!

entries.en: ✆ Like I said before, I'm not too good with people.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f我之前也说过，我不太擅长跟人打交道。

entries.en: ✆ Listen buddy it's not because I gave you my contact that it gives you the right to wake me up in the middle of the day.
entries.zh: §b✆§f 听着伙计,我把联系方式给了你,不代表你就能大白天把我吵醒。

entries.en: ✆ Listen, I don't have a ton of time right now, the object of my current research has just been stolen!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f听着,我现在没多少时间——正在研究的东西刚刚被偷了!

entries.en: ✆ Looks like you've completed the INFERNAL tier of Kuudra, so I'll consider you worthy.
entries.zh: ✆ 看来你已经通关了 Kuudra 炼狱难度，我认可你的资格。

entries.en: ✆ Ma' always told me to worry of stuff I don't understand.
entries.zh: ✆ 我妈总说,搞不懂的东西要多留个心眼。

entries.en: ✆ Make sure to wear Fairy Armor!
✆ Matter of fact, I've got seven siblings alone that would probably want to be in it...
entries.zh: §b✆ §f光是我那七个兄弟姐妹,估计就都想在里面占个位置……

entries.en: ✆ Maybe he can tell you where he put the relay?
entries.zh: ✆ 说不定他能告诉你中继装在哪儿?

entries.en: ✆ Maybe if you reach enough reputation...but maybe not...
entries.zh: §b✆ §f等你的§a声望§f足够高再说吧……也未必会给你……

entries.en: ✆ Mhm... Your face just isn't very scary...
entries.zh: §b✆§f 嗯……你这张脸实在不怎么吓人……

entries.en: ✆ Most of the Dwarves are pretty against all of this newer tech, so I've got plenty of space in my directory.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f大部分矮人都挺排斥这些新玩意儿,所以我通讯录里空位多得很。
§b✆ §f我的 Abiphone 联系方式? 没问题!

entries.en: ✆ My favorite thing to do at the moment is to collect cool-looking rocks.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f最近我最喜欢的事，就是收集那些好看的石头。

entries.en: ✆ My frogs are going to love that, thanks a lot!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f我家的青蛙一定喜欢，多谢啦!

entries.en: ✆ Nice to see you're still alive and kicking.
entries.zh: ✆ 看你还活蹦乱跳的，挺好。

entries.en: ✆ Not much else to do around here, really.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f说真的,这儿也没什么别的乐子。

entries.en: ✆ Now I can finally add Cole, and you!
entries.zh: ✆ 这下终于能加科尔了,当然还有你!

entries.en: ✆ Now let's see, what should I ask for it...
entries.zh: §b✆ §f让我想想，该找你要点什么呢……

entries.en: ✆ Now that I have this, the possibilities are endless!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f有了这个,可能性就无穷无尽了!

entries.en: ✆ Now there's both Kat AND you!
entries.zh: ✆ 现在里面有凯特,还有你了!

entries.en: ✆ Odger like Lasea. Lasea like fish. Odger like fish.
entries.zh: §b✆§f 奥杰喜欢拉西亚。拉西亚喜欢鱼。奥杰喜欢鱼。

entries.en: ✆ Odger put name in funny device? Hmm...
entries.zh: §b✆§f 把奥杰的名字放进怪东西? 唔……

entries.en: ✆ Of course I can add you as a contact!
entries.zh: §b✆§f 当然可以把你加进联系人啦!

entries.en: ✆ Oh and also, you need to have earned a GOLD medal in his contest if you want to be on MY list!
entries.zh: ✆ 哦对了,想进我的通讯录,你还得在他的竞赛里拿过金牌才行!

entries.en: ✆ Oh, it's you! So the Queen welcomed you in our Faction? That's great
entries.zh: §b✆ §f哦,是你! 女王已经接纳你加入我们的阵营了?太好了!

entries.en: ✆ Okay I added 9f™ Operator Chip to your Abiphone plan.
entries.zh: ✆ 好了,我把 9f™ 运营商芯片加进你的 Abiphone 套餐了。

entries.en: ✆ One last thing - not every NPC owns an Abiphone, so you can't add everyone as a Contact.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f最后提醒一句:不是每个 NPC 都有§3Abiphone§f,所以并非所有人都能加为联系人。

entries.en: ✆ One night, one of my regulars got a bit rowdy and took off towards the Abandoned Quarry.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f有天晚上,我一位老主顾闹腾起来,一路跑去了§2废弃采石场§f。

entries.en: ✆ Only call me if you have something urgent to talk about.
✆ Oooh an Abiphone, and a fancy one!
✆ Oooh an Abiphone, thank you so much!
✆ Or the sun! If you're that kind of person...
entries.zh: ✆ 或者说朝着太阳! 如果你是那种人的话……

entries.en: ✆ Please meet me at my house if you have one. I would greatly appreciate it!
entries.zh: ✆ 如果你有,请来我家找我。我会非常感激!

entries.en: ✆ Please only call me during business hours.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f麻烦只在营业时间给我打电话。

entries.en: ✆ Plus, it's a magical object, so it's not that bad.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f再说了，它也是魔法物品，倒也没那么糟。

entries.en: ✆ Say, do you think you could get me a Figstone?
entries.zh: §b✆ §f对了，你能帮我弄一块 §5Figstone§f 吗?

entries.en: ✆ Scarleton itself has one of the most robust connection to the 9f™ Network.
entries.zh: ✆ 绯红城本身就是 9f™ 网络信号最强的地方之一。

entries.en: ✆ So generously in fact that we also share some of the data from the 9f™ Network with one of the mayor candidates.
entries.zh: ✆ 阔绰到我们还把 9f™ 网络的一部分数据分享给了某位市长候选人。

entries.en: ✆ So my abiphone contacts list is FILLED with TONS of other pet lovers.
entries.zh: ✆ 所以我的 Abiphone 通讯录里塞满了一大堆宠物迷。

entries.en: ✆ So, if you want your digits in my phone, imma need you to get me something...
entries.zh: §b✆ §f所以啊,想把你的号码存进来,得帮我带点东西……

entries.en: ✆ Such lovely weather in this little ol' cave today, isn't it?
entries.zh: §b✆ §f今天这小破山洞里天气真不错,你说是吧?

entries.en: ✆ Tell you what, here's a compromise.
✆ Thank you for helping with the tentacle monster.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f谢谢你帮忙对付那只触手怪。

entries.en: ✆ Thank you so much - I think I'll fashion it into a necklace.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f太感谢你了——我打算把它做成一条项链。

entries.en: ✆ Thanks for the help, here's my contact.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f谢谢你帮忙,这是我的联系方式。

entries.en: ✆ Thanks for the pelts! A man can never have enough of them.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f谢啦! 毛皮这东西,再多也不嫌多。

entries.en: ✆ That thing is basically the holy grail to a junk collector like me.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f对我这样的废品收藏家来说,那简直就是圣杯啊。

entries.en: ✆ That way you'll be able to access my features from anywhere?
entries.zh: §b✆ §f这样你在哪儿都能找我办事了?

entries.en: ✆ That would show me you're a pet lover too!
entries.zh: ✆ 那就说明你也是个宠物迷!

entries.en: ✆ That's awesome, but now my Abiflip is full.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f太好了,不过这下我的 Abiflip 也存满了。
§b✆ §f就这些。好好享用你的新手机吧!

entries.en: ✆ That's not what I asked for!
✆ The first relay is on a branch of the large tree on the north-east of the fairy pond.
entries.zh: ✆ 第一个中继在仙女池塘东北边那棵大树的树枝上。

entries.en: ✆ The monsters ate his toy again! I don't know what to do!
entries.zh: ✆ 怪物又把他的玩具吃了! 我真不知道该怎么办!

entries.en: ✆ The next relay is in the Royal Palace within the Dwarven Mines.
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在矮人矿山的皇家宫殿里。

entries.en: ✆ The next relay is in the castle ruins!
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在城堡废墟里!

entries.en: ✆ The next relay is on the highest spike of The End.
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在末地最高的那根尖塔上。

entries.en: ✆ The next relay is on top of a statue in the dungeon hub.
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在地牢大厅的一座雕像顶上。

entries.en: ✆ The next relay is on top of the Auction House.
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在拍卖行的屋顶上。

entries.en: ✆ The next relay is on top of the shack next to the shady inn right here close to the pond.
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继就在池塘附近那家可疑小旅馆旁边的小屋顶上。

entries.en: ✆ The next relay was placed by our consultant, Odger.
entries.zh: ✆ 下一个中继是我们的顾问奥杰装的。

entries.en: ✆ The one that doesn't have a fairy soul...
entries.zh: ✆ 就是没有仙女之魂的那座……
✆ 这些画可不会自己画完!

entries.en: ✆ They'll know if you tell anyone.
entries.zh: ✆ 你要是说出去,他们会知道的。

entries.en: ✆ This Chocoberry looks great, perfect condition even!
entries.zh: §b✆ §f这个 §aChocoberry§f 真不错，状态简直完美!

entries.en: ✆ This gives me everything I need.
✆ This is the stuff. The good stuff.
✆ To see who you can add, simply open up your phone and check the Contacts Directory.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f想知道能添加谁,打开手机查看§3联系人目录§f就行。

entries.en: ✆ Usually we wouldn't have a relay serve so few people, but we were paid generously by anonymous contributors!
entries.zh: ✆ 平时我们不会为这么少的人专门架一个中继,不过有匿名人士出手阔绰!

entries.en: ✆ We need to upgrade all of the 9f™ Network Relays spread across SkyBlock.
entries.zh: ✆ 我们得把分布在 SkyBlock 各处的 9f™ 网络中继全部升级一遍。

entries.en: ✆ We owe the Piglins an apology.
✆ Well that's not possible, I'm only available at night.
entries.zh: §b✆§f 那可不行,我只在晚上出没。

entries.en: ✆ Well, I suppose it wouldn't do any harm.
✆ Well, I'll give you it if you play a game with me.
✆ Well, I'm a man of my word. Here's my contact.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f说到做到,这是我的联系方式。

entries.en: ✆ Well, now that I think about it, my little girl got me one for my birthday a few months back.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f这么一说,几个月前过生日,我女儿还真送过我一个。

entries.en: ✆ Well, outside of the fabled Arkenstone, that is.
entries.zh: §b✆ §f当然啦,传说中的§d阿肯宝钻§f不算在内。

entries.en: ✆ What about some more Luxurious Spool, hum?
✆ What did you just say? You recovered it? And they didn't even see you?
entries.zh: §b✆ §f你刚才说什么?你把它找回来了?而且他们根本没发现你?

entries.en: ✆ What do you think it is?
✆ What kind of chum would that make me?
✆ Why is the tooth fairy so smart?
✆ Wow, you figured out the maintenance plan!
entries.zh: ✆ 哇,你把维护方案搞明白了!

entries.en: ✆ Wow, you're a true pet lover!
entries.zh: ✆ 哇,你是货真价实的宠物迷!

entries.en: ✆ Ya sure can add my contact, against 10 Jacob's Ticket, eh?
